title: Nourishing Savory German Padron Peppers Skillet
description: A savory and festive German dish featuring padron peppers, this skillet is perfect for a weeknight dinner and is whole30-friendly.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the sliced pork sausage.
Cook the sausage until browned, about 5 minutes, then remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the padron peppers to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and season with salt and black pepper.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the skillet for 10 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
